[7, 10, 16, 19] DC Comics announced the revival of its "Elseworlds" imprint, starting with six new series, and held multiple panels, including "Elsewhere in the DC Multiverse" and "Metropolis All-Stars," to discuss upcoming comic storylines with various creators. [2, 10, 11] Additionally, a new creator-owned and operated media company, Ghost Machine, was launched in partnership with Image Comics. [3, 12, 13] Headed by prominent creators like Geoff Johns, Ghost Machine will feature four shared universes of characters. [3, 12] <2> On October 4, 2023, the Comic-Con Museum in San Diego debuted three new exhibits for its fall season. The headlining attraction, 'Popnology,' is an interactive exhibit exploring the influence of past pop culture on modern technology. [3, 5] The event featured a wide array of celebrity guests, artists, writers, voice actors, cosplayers, and entertainers, offering attendees opportunities for autographs and photo ops. [5] [8, 6] <4> The 2023 Rose City Comic Con, a major Pacific Northwest pop culture event, was held at the Oregon Convention Center from September 22-24, 2023. [3, 8] The event, which was expected to draw over 50,000 attendees, featured a wide array of programming. [1] This included panels with celebrity guests such as Zoe Saldana, Karen Gillan, Ralph Macchio, and the cast of Critical Role, as well as a large Artist Alley with a focus on creators from Portland and the Pacific Northwest. [5, 8] Additional highlights were a cosplay competition, a 'Weird Stage' for unique performances, a Star Wars Fan Experience, and extensive tabletop and video gaming areas. [1, 7, 8] <5> The Really Cool Comic Con, billed as Michigan's largest summer comic convention, took place at the Dort Financial Center in Flint, Michigan on Saturday, August 5, and Sunday, August 6, 2023. [3, 6] The community-focused event was designed to offer a more intimate and affordable experience for fans of all things pop culture. [3, 4] Highlights included appearances by comic artists, anime voice actors, and hall of fame wrestlers, as well as a cosplay contest and video game tournaments with cash prizes. The 2023 event, which ran from October 13-15, encompassed a wide range of genres including science fiction, fantasy, comics, anime, horror, gaming, and film & television. The primary and more extensively documented event, **ComiCon Erie**, took place from **Friday, September 8th to Sunday, September 10th, 2023**, at the Bayfront Convention Center. This event was a broad celebration of pop culture, encompassing not just comic books but also anime, superheroes, and cosplay. A significant feature of ComiCon Erie was the inclusion of "Brick Erie," which showcased impressive Lego creations. The convention featured celebrity guests, artist alleys, vendor booths selling nostalgic toys and other merchandise, gaming tournaments, and panels. A month later, on **Saturday, October 7, 2023**, a separate event named **ErieCon** was held in the city. This one-day convention was specifically tailored to fans of a wide array of comic book genres. While ErieCon focused intently on the diversity of the comic genre, the larger ComiCon Erie offered a more expansive "pop culture event" experience for a broader audience. There is no indication from available sources that the two events were related. The announcement for ErieCon's date was noted in an online comic convention calendar published on September 4, 2023. A separate, one-day event, ErieCon, took place on October 7, 2023, and was specifically noted for its focus on a diverse range of comic genres. The more widely reported event was ComiCon Erie, which offered a larger-scale pop culture experience." <8> Visioncon, a pop culture convention held in Springfield, Missouri, took place from October 13-15, 2023. [4] The event, which has been running for over 30 years, offers a wide array of attractions for fans of various genres, including comic books, science fiction, and fantasy. [5, 7] A significant feature of the convention is its dedicated gaming hall, which includes both tabletop and electronic gaming options for attendees. [4] Visioncon is a non-profit, volunteer-run event that raises money for local charities. [5, 8] <9> San Diego Comic-Con International took place from Thursday, July 20, to Sunday, July 23, 2023, with a preview night on Wednesday, July 19. A dominant theme of the event was the ongoing WGA and SAG-AFTRA strikes, which led to the cancellation or scaling back of many major studio panels and prohibited writers and actors from promoting their work. This resulted in a significantly reduced presence of film and TV celebrities. Despite this, the convention still sold out and was well-attended, with many attendees expressing that the reduced Hollywood focus did not detract from their experience. In the absence of major film and TV studio presentations, other media took center stage. In the comic book world, Marvel announced a new Punisher series featuring a new character, Joe Garrison, a retired S.H.I.E.L.D. agent. DC and Legendary Comics revealed a 'Justice League vs. Godzilla vs. Kong' crossover miniseries. The video game sector had a strong presence, with Insomniac Games holding a major panel for 'Marvel's Spider-Man 2' that included a new story trailer and the reveal of a special edition PS5 console. In television news, the premiere date for 'The Boys' spinoff, 'Gen V,' was announced as September 29, 2023. Additionally, a teaser trailer for the 'The Walking Dead' spinoff starring Rick and Michonne was released, revealing its new title, 'The Walking Dead: The Ones Who Live,' and a 2024 premiere window.
